title: Latent variable models for simultaneous EOV identification and removal in population-based SHM
abstract: arXiv:2608.11995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The robust treatment of environmental and operational variability (EOV) is an open challenge in population-based structural health monitoring (PBSHM). The difficulty is compounded in the case that the EOV signals are unmeasured. A common approach in conventional SHM is to apply \emph{projection-based} methods that discard subspaces of healthy feature data, reasoning that the EOV signal dominates the variance of the measured features. However, a common pitfall of projection-based approaches is that when damage acts close to the same variance-dominant direction, damage sensitivity is removed along with the EOV. An alternative identifying assumption for the removal of particular unmeasured EOVs is slowness; the latent EOV process is characterised by its long temporal correlation. In this paper, the latent EOV is cast as a state-space Gaussian process, enabling tractable $\mathcal{O}(T)$ inference via a Kalman filter. A robust hierarchical

translated_title: 基于潜变量模型的群体结构健康监测中环境与运行变异性同步识别与去除
translated_abstract: 在群体结构健康监测（PBSHM）中，对环境与运行变异性（EOV）的鲁棒处理仍是一个开放挑战。当EOV信号未被测量时，问题更加复杂。传统SHM中的常用方法是采用基于投影的方法，丢弃健康特征数据的子空间，理由是EOV信号主导了测量特征的方差。然而，基于投影方法的一个常见缺陷是，当损伤作用方向与方差主导方向接近时，损伤敏感性会随EOV一同被去除。另一种用于去除特定未测量EOV的识别假设是“慢变性”；潜在EOV过程以其长时相关性为特征。本文将潜在EOV建模为状态空间高斯过程，通过卡尔曼滤波器实现可处理的$\mathcal{O}(T)$推理，并采用鲁棒的层次化结构。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于状态空间高斯过程的潜变量模型，通过利用EOV的慢变性假设，在群体结构健康监测中同时识别和去除未测量的环境与运行变异性，避免了传统投影方法损伤敏感性损失的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a latent variable model based on state-space Gaussian processes that leverages the slowness assumption of EOV to simultaneously identify and remove unmeasured environmental and operational variability in population-based SHM, avoiding the damage sensitivity loss of traditional projection methods.
